final: WITH filtered_join AS (SELECT sf.zoneref, s.entrystat, sf.traitcount FROM scanfeatures sf INNER JOIN sites s ON sf.zoneref = s.zoneregistry WHERE sf.traitcount > 489), grouped AS (SELECT zoneref, entrystat, AVG(traitcount) as avg_traitcount, COUNT(*) as record_count FROM filtered_join GROUP BY zoneref, entrystat), with_total AS (SELECT zoneref, entrystat, avg_traitcount, record_count, SUM(record_count) OVER () as total_records FROM grouped) SELECT zoneref, entrystat, avg_traitcount, record_count, CAST(record_count AS REAL) / total_records as fraction FROM with_total WHERE total_records > 0 ORDER BY fraction DESC LIMIT 10
